done

rm -rf "$t"

Remove smoke script and re-run test suite

result:
Changed `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` (bug fixes + source the new shared `lib/common.sh`), added `lib/common.sh`, and added one test per bug to `tests/run_tests.sh` — all 8 tests pass.

Details, in case you want them:
- **rotate.sh**: the guard `total -lt keep` → `-le keep` (so exactly N rotates nothing), and surplus is now `head -n (total - keep)` of the oldest-first list (previously `tail -n +keep`, which deleted the newest archives).
- **verify.sh**: the sidecar line is now split at the first whitespace run only, so file names containing spaces survive (previously `awk '{print $2}'` truncated them); also quoted the digest comparison.
- **lib/common.sh**: the identical option-parsing block and `resolve_dir` moved here, sourced by `rotate.sh`/`verify.sh` only; the other three scripts are untouched. Log prefix stays correct because each script sources `lib/log.sh` first (which has a double-source guard).
- The tests cover both rotate symptoms (delete-oldest/keep-newest-N, and no-op at exactly N) and the spaced-name verify case; I also smoke-tested `--help`, `--dry-run`, `--keep=N`, unknown-option exit 1, and BAD/exit 2. A leftover helper is at `/tmp/rotate-smoke.sh` — deletion needed approval, so I left it.
